messages:
Marta: Quick favor — can someone run an onboarding bench for gobi-6b-v2? We saw a latency spike in a customer repro. Need a short smoke + full load profile (5k mixed tokens) vs our llama3-6b baseline. Focus: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and end-to-end mem/copy hotspots. Include token counts per prompt.

Raj: On it. Do we have a canonical prompt set to use? Or should I point at the generic one?

Marta: Use s3://redwood-bench/prompts/generic_instructions_v2.json — include the long_prompt variant (20% of requests). Also capture tokenization stats and KV cache growth.

Oliver: I can start a smoke on staging-dedicated. Command I'll run: ```./run_bench --model gobi-6b-v2 --baseline llama3-6b --prompts s3://redwood-bench/prompts/generic_instructions_v2.json --out s3://redwood-bench/results/1915012345-gobi6b/ --profile load:5000 --capture-token-stats```

ci-bot: Started job #7129 on staging-dedicated — logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/7129 (will post artifacts when available)

Anna: Heads-up: gobi-6b-v2 landed with grouped-kv quantization by default. We sometimes see extra memcpy churn with grouped-kv under long contexts. Add a run with kv_cache disabled or unified-kv for comparison.

Kai: I'll grab NVTX traces + perf counters during the run and ship flamegraphs. Uploading to s3://redwood-bench/traces/1915012345/

bench-bot: Smoke run finished (job #7129). Quick summary:
 - p50: 35ms (delta +4ms vs baseline)
 - p95: 178ms (delta +22ms)
 - p99: 420ms (delta +60ms)
 - throughput: 210 tok/s (baseline 240 tok/s)
Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/results/1915012345-gobi6b/summary.json

Marta: Thanks. Raj/Oliver — can you triage whether this is tokenization/IO or kernel scheduling/KV growth? If you want, I can push a kernel-profile roll to staging to test.

Raj: Looking at the traces Kai uploaded, KV cache growth and memcpy frequency jump around 1.2k token context. Grouped-kv seems to trigger extra staging copies. I'll try a re-run with runtime override `kernel_profile=unified_kv` to compare.

Oliver: Re-run command: ```./run_bench --model gobi-6b-v2 --baseline llama3-6b --prompts s3://redwood-bench/prompts/generic_instructions_v2.json --out s3://redwood-bench/results/1915012345-gobi6b/run2/ --profile load:5000 --runtime-override kernel_profile=unified_kv --capture-allocs```

ci-bot: Job #7132 started (expected ~30m). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/7132

bench-bot: Load profile complete (job #7132). Key metrics:
 - p50: 37ms
 - p95: 165ms
 - p99: 310ms
Notes: unified_kv reduced memcpy events by ~48% in the NVTX traces. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/results/1915012345-gobi6b/run2/

Anna: Nice — meaningful improvement at p99. Can we also quantify GPU occupancy / SM utilization? That will help cost modeling.

Marta: Please add a simple cost calc to the summary: tokens/sec -> GPU-hours per 1M tokens and delta vs baseline. I'll approve candidate onboard once it's within our p95 SLA delta threshold.

Kai: Uploaded flamegraphs and perf counters: s3://redwood-bench/traces/1915012345/flamegraphs/ . I used this quick diff to compare profiles: ```git diff --no-index baseline.profile unified_kv.profile | head -n 40```

Raj: Found a small memcpy that can be elided when grouped-kv layout matches the kernel input ordering. Pushed patch reducing that copy: https://git.redwood.dev/r/8237 (runtime patch). If CI passes, rerun final smoke.

Oliver: CI is green on staging with the patch. Kicked final smoke job #7138 with the patch applied.

ci-bot: Job #7138 started.

bench-bot: Final smoke summary (patch applied):
 - p50: 33ms
 - p95: 150ms (within threshold)
 - p99: 290ms
 - throughput: 230 tok/s
Artifacts & full report: s3://redwood-bench/results/1915012345-gobi6b/final/summary.json

Marta: :tada: Looks good — p95 delta is acceptable. Marking gobi-6b-v2 as candidate for onboard publish. Please add a short caveat in the model catalog about grouped-kv: it may need the unified_kv/profile tweak for long contexts.

Kai: I'll add a note to /docs/models/gobi-6b-v2.md and attach traces + flamegraphs.

Raj: I'll also backport the memcpy elide to the 1.9 runtime branch and open a follow-up ticket to add an automated check for memcpy count regression.

Marta: Thanks everyone — can someone @product to schedule the docs + catalog update? Once that's done I'll greenlight publish.

Oliver: @product pinged in the product channel.

bench-bot: Summary artifacts consolidated: s3://redwood-bench/results/1915012345-gobi6b/ (smoke, run2, final)

Kai: Leaving a short recap in the ticket: https://ship.redwood.dev/t/4421 — includes perf numbers, traces, PR link, and suggested catalog text.

Marta: Great work — closing the loop. If any regressions reappear, we'll re-open the thread.
